title: [Bug]: Inconsistent Streaming Response Handling between OpenAI and Gemini LLM Classes
body:
### Bug Description

## Description
There's an inconsistency in how the `stream_complete` method returns data between different LLM provider classes. Specifically, there's a difference in how streaming chunks are handled in the `CompletionResponse` objects between OpenAI and Gemini implementations:

- **OpenAI**: Places the new chunk in `delta` and the accumulated text in `text`
- **Gemini**: Places the new chunk in `text` and nothing in `delta`

This inconsistency makes it difficult to write provider-agnostic code that handles streaming responses.

## Current Behavior
When streaming completions:

**OpenAI Implementation**
- `response.text` - Contains the complete text accumulated so far
- `response.delta` - Contains only the new chunk that was just received

**Gemini Implementation**
- `response.text` - Contains only the new chunk that was just received
- `response.delta` - Is `None`

## Expected Behavior
All LLM provider classes should follow the same pattern in their `stream_complete` method:
- `response.text` should consistently contain either the accumulated text or just the chunk
- `response.delta` should consistently contain either the new chunk or be `None`

Based on the `CompletionResponse` class documentation, the expected behavior should be:
- `response.text`: "Text content of the response if not streaming, or if streaming, the current extent of streamed text."
- `response.delta`: "New text that just streamed in (only relevant when streaming)."

## Relevant Code References
**In OpenAI**:
https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/afe3dcbf59a972fc697571d92b4972dd1ef1b751/llama-index-integrations/llms/llama-index-llms-openai/llama_index/llms/openai/base.py#L599-L625

**In Gemini**:
https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/afe3dcbf59a972fc697571d92b4972dd1ef1b751/llama-index-integrations/llms/llama-index-llms-gemini/llama_index/llms/gemini/base.py#L223-L235
https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/afe3dcbf59a972fc697571d92b4972dd1ef1b751/llama-index-integrations/llms/llama-index-llms-gemini/llama_index/llms/gemini/utils.py#L40-L57

## Suggested Fix
Update the Gemini implementation to match the OpenAI implementation's behavior (or vice versa), ensuring that:
- One field consistently contains the accumulated text
- One field consistently contains just the new chunk

## Additional Information
This inconsistency makes it challenging to create tools or abstractions that work with multiple LLM providers, as special handling is required for each provider's streaming response format.

### Version

0.12.23

### Steps to Reproduce

- Use the OpenAI LLM class's `stream_complete` method and observe the values of `text` and `delta` in each yielded `CompletionResponse`.
- Use the Gemini LLM class's `stream_complete` method and observe the values of `text` and `delta` in each yielded `CompletionResponse`.

linked_prs.body:
# Description

This PR fixes the streaming inconsistency in `llama-index-llms-gemini` by ensuring that the `stream_complete` method accumulates text in `response.text` and sets new chunks in `response.delta`, aligning with OpenAI's behavior as per the `CompletionResponse` documentation. The issue was that Gemini's `stream_complete` previously set `response.text` to the new chunk and `response.delta` to `None`, which did not match the expected behavior.

## Relevant Motivation and Context
The inconsistency between Gemini and OpenAI implementations could cause confusion for users expecting uniform behavior across LLM providers in LlamaIndex. This fix ensures consistency, making the Gemini integration more reliable for streaming use cases.
